summary: Recover each browser outbox scope once before exposing its send repository

replay.detail: Startup recovery never submits saved actions. Unknown attempts remain non-retryable; explicit applied:none retains the existing deliberate fresh-child retry policy.

schema.detail: Reuses existing browser-local IndexedDB envelopes and storage namespace without migration.

compatibility.detail: Scoped repositories wait for one shared initialization barrier with a current identity check. Restored never-dispatched thread Start and reply require original-target revalidation before acquiring a dispatch permit. Missing issuer remains explicitly unprotected.

downtime.detail: No service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes are required.

recovery.detail: Initialization preserves pending preparation/ready work, demotes unresolved dispatch markers to unknown, and retains corruption as discard-only recovery. Repeated initialization and recovery inspection do not demote the same connection's live dispatch. Foreign-scope records remain unchanged. A new tab may demote an in-flight marker while a later identity-correlated receipt can still settle it. Storage failures remain unavailable, not corrupt.
